body:
Track 10 milestone 6 (`swe-prompt`), partial. Simulates fixed-n, peek-every-pair and a mixture SPRT on ledger-shaped outcomes. Peeking gives 21% (success rate) to 40% (value) false positives against a nominal 5%; the mSPRT stays under 5% but a 97% success rate needs ~2,200 runs for a 2-point change. Stylised: all 244 ledger rows are prompt 0, effects hypothetical, no candidate brief run. 7 tests; `site/build.py` prints ok; citations checked (Johari et al., Howard et al., Robbins).
